title: Season Accuracy gets its own page
text: The live record, the accuracy charts, the calibration table and every graded pick moved from Checking the AI's work to a Season Accuracy page of their own, as the NHL's and the NFL's pages have. This page, What's Changed, was added the same day.

title: The drift check compares like with like, a day at a time
text: Each of the drift check's five looks is now held to the backtest's log loss over as many games into a season, not to its whole-season figure, and its bootstrap resamples whole game days, because games on one night share that night's injury news and prices (experiments/nba/stage65/registry.json, drift.amended_2026_11_11 and drift.amended_2026_11_11_days).

title: Each pick is held to a like-for-like baseline
text: A pick saved without the injury report was made by Model A without its availability term, so the drift check now holds it to that model's backtest log loss, not to the full Model A's (experiments/nba/stage65/registry.json, drift.amended_2026_11_05).

title: Two disclosures about the market
text: The registration now says that every priced pick saved before this date came from a Model B fitted on earlier seasons only, and that the live market is the price when the pick is saved while the backtest's is the closing price. No rule or pick changed (experiments/nba/stage65/registry.json).

title: The drift check looks five times a season
text: Instead of testing every graded pick at every run, the check looks at 100, 200, 400, 800 and 1,200 graded picks, each at one-sided 99%, the season's 95% shared among the five looks (experiments/nba/stage65/registry.json, drift.amended_2026_11_04).

title: Model B learns from this season's priced games
text: Each of this season's final games now enters Model B's training with the price the daily runs recorded before it started. Model A does not read the price and is unchanged. Picks saved before this date stay as saved (experiments/nba/stage65/registry.json).

title: An unreadable injury row costs only its own team
text: A player row on the injury report that cannot be read now takes availability away from its own team's games only, not from every game (experiments/nba/stage65/registry.json, availability.amended_2026_11_04).

title: Models fitted only on earlier days
text: Each run now refits the models on games played strictly before the day being picked, as the backtest does. Before this, a run after the day's first games had fitted on them before picking that day's later ones. A saved pick is never rewritten, so the few picks affected stay as saved and are listed in the registration. The registration also now says when, and by which rule, the season's verdict is taken, and why the board shows Model B's pick although the backtest found the market better (experiments/nba/stage65/registry.json).

title: The NBA's picks go live
text: The daily run saves each game's pick before tip-off, with the price and the injury report it read at that moment, and grades it once the game is final. The forward test and its drift check were registered first, on 2026-10-09 (experiments/nba/stage65/registry.json).

title: Model A and Model B, registered and backtested
text: Model A reads three matchups between the clubs: points, efficiency and who is available. Model B adds the market. Both were registered before either was fitted (experiments/nba/stage61/registry.json) and answered once on the confirmation seasons: Model A beats the base rate, and Model B beats Model A, but Model B does worse than the market alone.
